title: Club-suit rank collision: card soldiers Ace-Ten of Clubs vs gardeners 2/5/7 and royal gardeners 3/4/6/8/9/10

evidence.value: club-suit pips with rank indices Ace to Ten of Clubs, one rank per soldier
ranks Three, Four, Six, Eight, Nine, Ten of Clubs; 'Never use numerals 2, 5 or 7'

problem: Every club rank from 2 to 10 is claimed twice: the ten soldiers take Ace to Ten, and the nine gardeners (three named plus six background) take 2 to 10. So a 'Five of Clubs' soldier and Gardener Five are both on the croquet ground in ch008. The royal-gardener card protects the named trio's numerals from the background gardeners but not from the soldiers. Caps and batons tell the soldiers apart in costume, but the card faces themselves collide, and the named trio are meant to be identifiable by numeral.
workaround_in_this_task: The soldier representative sheet uses the Ace of Clubs, the only club rank not claimed by a gardener. No Bible file edited.
suggested_options: A: soldiers take a different suit or an Ace-plus-court-card range (reading 'carrying clubs' as the baton, not the suit).
B: soldiers keep clubs, and the named trio are marked by something extra (paint, brush) rather than numeral alone. Accept the duplicate numerals.
C: fewer soldier ranks shown on camera (e.g. only Ace, Jack-style court numbers are not in the text).
decision_owner: 03-characters/appearance (card content), user at H2 if the suit reading changes

resolution.authority: H2 art-style lock, gate G4, approval ba96732d (runs/g4/gate.json)
resolution.decision: The card soldiers KEEP the club suit and ranks Ace-Ten. The gardeners (named trio and background ensemble) keep their numerals but move to the SPADE suit. No card in the ch008 procession, rose-tree yard or croquet ground is now worn twice.
resolution.why_the_work_order_mechanism_could_not_b: The work order asked for the soldiers to be re-ranked instead. That is arithmetically impossible: a suit has 13 cards, and in the shared ch008 scene the claimants are 10 soldiers + 3 named gardeners + 6 background gardeners + the King and Queen of Clubs (CHAR-visiting-monarchs-ensemble M01/M02) = 19. Even ignoring the background gardeners it is 15 > 13, so no re-ranking of the soldiers alone can clear the collision; one group has to leave the suit.
resolution.which_group_moved_and_why: Source precedence (SOUL arbitration rule: source text first, inferred:true yields to what is written). ch008-p11 'First came ten soldiers carrying clubs' - read in parallel with the diamond courtiers and the heart royal children - anchors the club suit to the soldiers, and ten soldiers need the suit's ten pip cards. The gardeners' suit is nowhere in the source (only their numbers Two, Five and Seven are), so it is the free variable; spades also suit garden staff and match the illustrated tradition. The work order's binding requirement - keep the named gardeners' numerals - is honoured exactly.

Nothing was regenerated: the user's auto-reroll budget is 0. The numerals - the only identifying feature and the only thing the source fixes - are unaffected. Re-rolling those four sheets needs an explicit user order or the preview page's Modify button. CHAR-gardener-two's sheet is in any case already non-conforming (it draws 3 pips instead of 2, logged in runs/p4-char-concept-cb3/result.json).
